note: Speed-ramp / retime presets for cuts/retime.py (ffmpeg setpts/atempo chains) and transitions/lib/tx-core.js RAMP_PRESETS (same keys and numbers). Times are seconds relative to the anchor (the hit). rate = source seconds per output second (0 = freeze). Segments of type reverse play src_dur seconds of source backwards. sfx ids follow sfx/<category>/<name>; anchor frame = cut + offset_f.

rampIn.use: ease into slow motion on the hit and stay there (hero product, sport)

rampOut.use: come out of slow motion back to real time (end of a hero moment)

heroRamp.use: fast-slow-fast: the classic action hero ramp, slowest frames ON the beat

bulletTime.use: near-freeze reveal with motion still visible

reverseFlash.use: rewind gag: 0.4 s of source played backwards at 2x, then forward again

freezeStamp.use: freeze frame with a stamp / name card ('that's me'); pair with type layout.freezeFrame
